single_partner_rule: One prime candidate at a time. First question is whether the candidate is already invited and participating. Provider-SENT becomes hard DNR until a genuine reply or material provider event.

routes.qualification_gate: Ask only whether InductiveHealth is already invited and actively evaluating/responding to this invitation-only RFP. No invitation or bid participation is inferred.

fit_facts: InductiveHealth markets disease-surveillance solutions to Federal, State, Tribal, Local and Territorial jurisdictions.
Its current EDSS capabilities include ELR and eCR, HL7 v2.x, FHIR R4, role-based access, audit trails and configurable public-health workflows.
Its services include NBS and EpiTrax implementation, data integration, Mirth and Rhapsody, MMG onboarding, hosting and data-quality support.
InductiveHealth says its platform and services support more than 40 public-health jurisdictions.
Its 2026 SSDI acquisition expanded NBS and public-health implementation expertise.
